text: Phân tích thị phần thương hiệu
sql:
SELECT b.brand_name, 
COUNT(p.product_id) as product_count,
ROUND(COUNT(p.product_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products), 2) as market_share_percent,
AVG(pr.current_price) as avg_price,
AVG(rv.rating_average) as avg_rating
FROM brands b 
JOIN products p ON b.brand_id = p.brand_id 
JOIN product_pricing pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id 
JOIN product_reviews rv ON p.product_id = rv.product_id 
GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name 
HAVING COUNT(p.product_id) >= 10
ORDER BY market_share_percent DESC 
LIMIT 20;

text: Phân tích giá theo khoảng từ 600k đến 1100k

SELECT 
CASE 
    WHEN pr.current_price < 600000 THEN 'Under 600K'
    WHEN pr.current_price BETWEEN 600000 AND 1100000 THEN '600K-1100K'
    ELSE 'Over 1100K'
END as price_range,

AVG(rv.rating_average) as avg_rating,
AVG(pr.current_price) as avg_price
FROM product_pricing pr 
JOIN product_reviews rv ON pr.product_id = rv.product_id 
GROUP BY price_range 
ORDER BY avg_price;

    WHEN pr.current_price < 700000 THEN 'Under 700K'
    WHEN pr.current_price BETWEEN 700000 AND 1200000 THEN '700K-1200K'
    ELSE 'Over 1200K'
END as price_range,
COUNT(*) as product_count,
AVG(rv.rating_average) as avg_rating,
AVG(pr.current_price) as avg_price
FROM product_pricing pr 
JOIN product_reviews rv ON pr.product_id = rv.product_id 
GROUP BY price_range 
ORDER BY avg_price;

text: Phân tích hiệu suất bán hàng theo thương hiệu và danh mục với thống kê chi tiết
sql:
SELECT b.brand_name, c.category_name,
COUNT(p.product_id) as total_products,
SUM(pr.quantity_sold) as total_sales,
AVG(pr.current_price) as avg_price,
AVG(rv.rating_average) as avg_rating,
SUM(pr.vnd_cashback) as total_cashback,
ROUND(AVG(pr.current_price) * SUM(pr.quantity_sold), 0) as estimated_revenue,
ROUND(SUM(pr.quantity_sold) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(quantity_sold) FROM product_pricing), 2) as market_share_percent
FROM brands b 
JOIN products p ON b.brand_id = p.brand_id 
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id 
JOIN product_pricing pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id 
JOIN product_reviews rv ON p.product_id = rv.product_id 
GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name, c.category_id, c.category_name 
HAVING COUNT(p.product_id) >= 5 AND SUM(pr.quantity_sold) > 0
ORDER BY estimated_revenue DESC, market_share_percent DESC 
LIMIT 20;

text: Sản phẩm Nike hoặc Adidas có đánh giá trên 4.3 sao
sql:
SELECT p.name, b.brand_name, c.category_name, pr.current_price, rv.rating_average
FROM products p 
JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id 
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id 
JOIN product_pricing pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id 
JOIN product_reviews rv ON p.product_id = rv.product_id 
WHERE (b.brand_name LIKE '%Nike%' OR b.brand_name LIKE '%Adidas%') 
AND rv.rating_average >= 4.3
ORDER BY rv.rating_average DESC, pr.current_price ASC 
LIMIT 15;

text: Top 15 sản phẩm có tỷ lệ đánh giá 5 sao cao nhất theo danh mục
sql:
SELECT p.name, c.category_name, b.brand_name, pr.current_price, rv.rating_average, rv.review_count,
ROUND((rv.favourite_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(rv.review_count, 0)), 2) as five_star_percentage
FROM products p 
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id 
JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id 
JOIN product_pricing pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id 
JOIN product_reviews rv ON p.product_id = rv.product_id 
WHERE rv.review_count >= 50 AND rv.rating_average >= 4.5
ORDER BY five_star_percentage DESC, rv.rating_average DESC 
LIMIT 15;
